generationPrompts.prompt: Create a faithful clean logo redraw of the business name visible on this actual dealer sign. Preserve the warm gold and simple block type. Exact text NAJEM AL TAREEQ, second line USED CARS TR L.L.C. Introduce a clearly designed compact NT monogram in the same plain block typographic style to the left as a proposed compact sign-derived mark. Dark gold #8b641e and deep near-black #141a21 for readability on white. True transparent background. Clean flat geometric typography, no facade, no photographic material, no texture, no gradient, no shadow, no slogan. Wide horizontal lockup with square NT emblem readable at 32px.

generationPrompts.prompt: Create the compact inverse surface variant of the left-hand emblem in this logo. ONLY the compact left emblem, absolutely no wordmark or business text. No background, no mockup, no labels, no gradient, no shadow, no texture, no distressed edges, no extra lines. Clean automotive identity asset with a recognizable silhouette at 32 pixels.
